column1: # ML-097 held-out list, group 'europe': consumer ISPs' mail and national mail providers in Europe outside the Nordic countries.
# Researched 2026-10-05 by one agent that only ran web searches and read public help pages (plus one Wayback Machine capture);
# no DNS lookups, no autoconfig/ISPDB/.well-known requests and no mail-port connections were made for any domain.
# Selection: per country, the largest ISPs/mail providers not already used or excluded (market ranks were not verified in this session; stated as such).
# Columns: domain, group, expect (settings|unsupported|no-mail|unknown), imap, smtp, evidence.
# Endpoint: host:port:tls|starttls:users, users = addr | local | other | local/addr; ' ; ' separates endpoints.

column6: https://assistance.free.fr/articles/609 ('Email Free : comment ajouter mon compte email Free dans mon application de messagerie ?', no date on the page, read 2026-10-05): SMTP smtp.free.fr 'sur les ports sécurisés STARTTLS 587 ou 465', SMTP authentication with the Free address and its password, 587 named 'par défaut' in the rejected-mail section; IMAP imap.free.fr 'sur le port sécurisé SSL 993, sinon sur le port 143' (143 has no encryption stated, not recorded); POP pop.free.fr 995/110; 'L'authentification doit se faire avec l'adresse email complète (domaine y compris)' -> user = full address; ambiguity: 465 is labelled STARTTLS together with 587, recorded as tls by port convention; selection: French ISPs after Orange (used): Free and SFR

https://assistance.sfr.fr/sfrmail-appli/sfrmail/configurer-messagerie-recevoir-email-sfr.html (read 2026-10-05): section for @sfr.fr, @neuf.fr, @cegetel.net and @9online.fr: SMTP smtp.sfr.fr port 465 'utilisation : TLS 1.2 ou TLS 1.3', 'nom de compte : adresse e-mail complète suivie de @sfr.fr (exemple : prenom.nom@sfr.fr)'; IMAP imap.sfr.fr port 993 'TLS 1.2 ou TLS 1.3'; POP pop.sfr.fr 995; the IMAP and POP 'nom de compte' lines of the SFR section say 'adresse e-mail complète suivie de @numericable.fr (exemple : prenom.nom@numericable.fr)', evidently copied from the Numericable section -> user = full address; encryption is named only by TLS version, implicit TLS inferred from ports 993/465; no 587/143 documented for SFR addresses; Numericable/Noos addresses use other hosts (smtps.numericable.fr etc., not recorded); sfr.fr pages are blocked for the search tool, the page was found from the assistance.sfr.fr SFR Mail index

https://www.vodafone.de/hilfe/vodafone-e-mail-cloud.html (read 2026-10-05): 'Diese Einstellungen gelten für alle E-Mail-Konten von Vodafone, Arcor, Kabel Deutschland und Unitymedia'; example address dein.name@vodafonemail.de (new registrations get up to 10 addresses @vodafonemail.de); 'Server Posteingang IMAP (empfohlen)' imap.vodafonemail.de, 'SSL: 993 / TLS: 143'; smtp.vodafonemail.de 'SSL: 465 / TLS: 25 oder 587'; 'Benutzer-/Kontoname: Deine vollständige E-Mail-Adresse' -> user = full address; password = the separate E-Mail-/IMAP-Passwort, not the MeinVodafone password; TLS mandatory since October 2024; ambiguity: 'TLS' on 143/587/25 is not spelled STARTTLS, recorded as starttls by port convention; the page's tariff FAQ says mail programs keep working in the free Freemail tariff; one row for the brand (same servers for Arcor, Kabel Deutschland and Unitymedia accounts); selection: German ISPs after Telekom (used): Vodafone (1&1 excluded)

https://kundenservice.freenet.de/faq/e-mail-client-mail/einstellungen-serverdaten-fuer-alle-e-mail-programme/ (undated, read 2026-10-05): SMTP-Server and IMAP-Server mx.freenet.de; 'Benutzer/Kontoname: name@domain (z.B. max.mustermann@freenet.de)' -> user = full address; SMTP-Port 587, Verschlüsselung 'erforderlich (STARTTLS / TLS / SSL)'; 'Verwendete Ports: STARTTLS: SMTP (Versand) 587, IMAP (Empfang) 143; SSL/TLS: SMTP (Versand) 465, IMAP (Empfang) 993'; POP3 discouraged; freenet's page does not say whether the free freenet Mail Basic tariff includes IMAP; third-party test https://www.netzwelt.de/e-mail/freenet-mail-basic-testbericht.html (dated 2024-10-17, read 2026-10-05 through a summarising fetch) says the account works over IMAP/POP3 after enabling it in the settings; a search result listed an autoconfig host of this domain, which was not opened; selection: German national mail provider (GMX/WEB.DE excluded, T-Online used)

https://www.virginmedia.com/help/broadband/manage-email-settings (read 2026-10-05): 'IMAP settings (recommended)': host imap.virginmedia.com, 'Username: your Virgin Media email address', 'SSL encryption: enabled', 'Port: 993'; SMTP smtp.virginmedia.com, 'Username: your full Virgin Media email address', 'SSL encryption: enabled', 'Port: 465', Authentication: Password -> user = full address; mail apps need a separate 'Virgin Media Mail app password' made in My Virgin Media; no 587/STARTTLS documented; https://www.virginmedia.com/help/broadband/email-account-closure (read 2026-10-05): mailboxes of former customers are closed (usually within 90 days of disconnection) and 'Virgin Media also no longer provide email accounts to new or returning customers'; existing customers' mailboxes continue; selection: UK ISPs after BT (used) and Sky (excluded): Virgin Media and TalkTalk

https://help-centre.talktalk.co.uk/Email/Set_up_TalkTalk_email/Email_settings_to_access_TalkTalk_emails (read 2026-10-05; .../Email/Check_settings/... redirects there): incoming mail.talktalk.net, 'Security Type (for Android) SSL/TLS or SSL', 'Encryption Method (for Windows/Mac Mail) SSL/TLS', port 993 for IMAP (995 for POP3); outgoing smtp.talktalk.net, 'Security Type (for Android) STARTTLS or TLS', 'Encryption Method (for Windows) STARTTLS', port 587; iOS 'Use SSL' on for both; the table has no username line; https://help-centre.talktalk.co.uk/Email/Set_up_TalkTalk_email/Setting_up_email_on_an_Android_device (read 2026-10-05): 'Log in /Username: enter your email address' and 'USERNAME: enter your full email address' -> user = full address; MD5 and SPA authentication no longer supported; no 465 documented

https://aiuto.libero.it/articolo/mail/configurare-libero-mail-con-client-di-posta-imap-e-smtp/ (article:modified_time 2026-08-31, read 2026-10-05): parameters 'per tutti i domini di Libero'; 'Nome utente: inserisci sempre l'indirizzo email col dominio (ad esempio @libero.it, @iol.it, @blu.it o @inwind.it)' -> user = full address; IMAP imapmail.libero.it 993 'Sicurezza: SSL (o SSL/TLS)'; SMTP smtp.libero.it 465 'SSL (o SSL/TLS)', 'Autenticazione: obbligatoria'; POP popmail.libero.it 995; no 587/143 documented; the page states no tariff restriction for mail clients (the paid Mail Plus plans were not checked); selection: Italian national mail provider (Italiaonline), TIM already used

WEAK: official pages unreadable, settings known only from search-engine extracts. Movistar's knowledge-base article https://comunidad.movistar.es/kb/correo_movistar/c%C3%B3mo-puedo-acceder-a-mi-cuenta-de-correo-movistar-es-o-telefonica-net/3904425 and community threads such as https://comunidad.movistar.es/discussions/Correo/no-consigo-configurar-mi-cuenta-telefonica-net-en-el-nuevo-outlook-2025/5226685 returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches on 2026-10-05; four web searches on 2026-10-05 gave consistent extracts of them: for @telefonica.net incoming imap.telefonica.net port 993 'Tipo de seguridad: SSL' (or pop3.telefonica.net 995), outgoing smtp.telefonica.net port 25 'Tipo de seguridad: TLS', 'Usuario: cuenta de correo electrónico' (read as the full address = ambiguity); @movistar.es uses imap.movistar.es/smtp.movistar.es with the same ports (not recorded, one domain per brand); one extract also gives an unencrypted IMAP 143/SMTP 25 variant (not recorded); port 25 'TLS' recorded as starttls; no 465/587 seen; extracts of third-party https://www.xataka.com/basics/correo-movistar-que-que-puedes-hacer-como-acceder-a-tu-cuenta say no new Movistar mail accounts since 2013, existing ones continue; selection: Movistar (Telefónica), Spain's largest ISP; Orange Spain skipped (orange brand excluded)

https://www.ziggo.nl/klantenservice/e-mail/serverinstellingen (read 2026-10-05): IMAP imap.ziggo.nl 'serverpoort: 993', 'type versleuteling: TLS/SSL', 'gebruikersnaam: volledig e-mailadres'; SMTP smtp.ziggo.nl 'serverpoort: 587', 'type versleuteling: STARTTLS, TLS of SSL', 'verificatie vereist: ja', 'gebruikersnaam: volledig e-mailadres' -> user = full address; 587 labelled with all three options, recorded as starttls (ambiguity); no 465 documented; settings valid for @ziggo.nl, @quicknet.nl, @home.nl, @casema.nl, @upcmail.nl, @chello.nl and @a2000.nl; selection: Dutch ISPs KPN (used) and Ziggo

https://www2.telenet.be/residential/nl/klantenservice/internet/e-mail/e-mail-instellen.html (read 2026-10-05): IMAP imap.telenet.be 'Poort: 993', 'Beveiligingstype: SSL'; 'Authenticated SMTP' smtp.telenet.be 'Poort: 587', 'Beveiligingstype: TLS', outgoing server needs 'je Telenet e-mailadres en wachtwoord'; POP pop.telenet.be 995 SSL(/TLS), unencrypted POP3 dropped since March 2022; https://www2.telenet.be/nl/klantenservice/stepplan-snippets/e-mailprogramma-instellen-voor-je-telenet-e-mailadres/outlook2010_stap5 (read 2026-10-05): 'Gebruikersnaam: vul je volledige Telenet e-mailadres' in -> user = full address; 587 labelled only 'TLS', recorded as starttls (ambiguity); no 465 documented; selection: Belgian ISPs Proximus (used) and Telenet

https://pomoc.wp.pl/jak-skonfigurowac-program-pocztowy (read 2026-10-05): IMAP imap.wp.pl port 993 'Tryb zabezpieczenia - SSL'; SMTP smtp.wp.pl port 465 'Tryb zabezpieczenia - SSL', 'Serwer wymaga uwierzytelnienia / włączonej autoryzacji SMTP'; POP3 pop3.wp.pl 995 SSL; no username line (the page only says most programs configure themselves from 'swój adres e-mail i hasło'), so the login form is undocumented (local/addr); with two-step login each program needs a 'hasło do programu pocztowego'; https://pomoc.wp.pl/aktywacja-dostepu-dla-programow-pocztowych (read 2026-10-05): IMAP or POP must first be switched on in webmail Opcje > IMAP/POP (default not stated); no 587/143 documented; selection: Polish portal mail services WP and Onet

https://pomoc.poczta.onet.pl/programy-pocztowe/adresy-serwerow-potrzebne-do-konfiguracji/x0e6sqz (reached from https://pomoc.poczta.onet.pl/baza-wiedzy/adresy-serwerow-potrzebne-do-konfiguracji/ by redirect, article dated 6 września 2018, read 2026-10-05): IMAP imap.poczta.onet.pl port 993 'Typ zabezpieczeń: SSL'; SMTP smtp.poczta.onet.pl port 465 'Typ zabezpieczeń: SSL'; 'Pamiętaj, że nazwa konta to cały adres e-mail np. jan.onetowy@onet.pl' -> user = full address; no 587/143 documented; whether IMAP must be switched on first was not checked; onet.pl pages are blocked for the search tool, the URL came from a third-party search result

https://napoveda.seznam.cz/cz/email/imap-pop3-smtp/ (redirects to https://o-seznam.cz/napoveda/email/mohlo-by-se-hodit/postovni-programy-a-aplikace/, read 2026-10-05): IMAP imap.seznam.cz 'Port: 993 (šifrované spojení SSL)'; SMTP smtp.seznam.cz 'Port: 465 (šifrované spojení SSL/TLS)', 'Server vyžaduje autentifikaci' must be ticked; POP3 pop3.seznam.cz 995; the full-address username rule is stated only for Email Profi (custom domains) and for CalDAV/CardDAV, so the IMAP login form for @seznam.cz is undocumented (local/addr); https://napoveda.seznam.cz/cz/email/chyby-v-postovnich-programech/pripojeni-k-serveru-se-nezdarilo/ (redirects to o-seznam.cz, read 2026-10-05): 'Pro šifrované spojení můžete nastavit i port 587' (mode not named, recorded as starttls by convention = ambiguity; unencrypted port 25 not recorded) and the outgoing-server username must be 'celou e-mailovou adresu' -> SMTP user = full address; unencrypted client ports are being phased out; selection: Seznam, Czech national mail provider (email.cz is the same service, one row per brand)

https://www.sunrise.ch/en/support/contracts-and-customer-information/e-mail-support/sunrise-mail (read 2026-10-05): 'Setting up e-mail account (IMAP/POP/SMTP settings)': IMAP 'Server: imap.sunrise.ch', 'Port: 993', 'Security protocol: SSL'; POP pop.sunrise.ch 995 SSL; SMTP 'Server: smtp2.sunrise.ch', 'Port: 465', 'Security protocol: SSL'; no username line, login form undocumented (local/addr); alias addresses such as @freesurf.ch can be used as sender; no 587/143 documented; the step-by-step page https://www.sunrise.ch/en/support/internet/set-up-e-mail-program is rendered by script and could not be read; selection: Swiss ISPs Swisscom (used) and Sunrise

https://ajuda.sapo.pt/configurar-programa-de-email-70015 (post dated 11.08.16, read 2026-10-05): IMAP imap.sapo.pt for addresses ending @sapo.pt 'Porta com SSL: 993'; SMTP smtp.sapo.pt 'Porta com SSL: 465 ou 587', authentication with 'o seu endereço de e-mail SAPO e a respetiva password' -> SMTP user = full address, IMAP login form not stated (local/addr); 587 labelled SSL like 465, recorded as starttls by convention (ambiguity); 'O acesso por IMAP, POP e SMTP só está disponível para contas Premium'; https://ajuda.sapo.pt/sapo-mail-premium-faqs-100385 (read 2026-10-05): free Base accounts are webmail-only, IMAP/POP needs a paid SAPO Mail Premium subscription that a SAPO Mail account can take out, and Premium users can block IMAP/POP in webmail ('Bloquear IMAP/POP'); expect=settings because the paid add-on is open to this address type; selection: SAPO is the portal mail of MEO (Altice Portugal)

No current official documentation found. eir's 'External Client Setting' article https://www.eir.ie/support/webmail/external-client-setting-outlook-windowsmail-applemail/ (URL from a web search) redirected to https://www.eir.ie/helpandsupport/ on 2026-10-05, and https://www.eir.ie/helpandsupport/webmail/ renders its articles by script (nothing readable); the last Wayback Machine capture of the article, http://web.archive.org/web/20220805021951/https://eir.ie/support/webmail/external-client-setting-outlook-windowsmail-applemail/ (read 2026-10-05), documented only POP3 webmail.eircom.net:110 'SSL/TLS (Security): None' and SMTP mail1.eircom.net:25 'SSL/TLS: None', 'Authentication: None', '(eir broadband customers only)': no IMAP and no encrypted endpoint, nothing recorded; third-party settings sites found by web search (e.g. https://www.getmailbird.com/setup/access-eircom-net-via-imap-smtp) claim IMAP webmail.eircom.net:993, not used as evidence; search extracts of news (https://thejournal.ie/eir-eircom-email-4991517-Feb2020) say eircom.net mail became a paid service in 2020; selection: eir, Ireland's incumbent operator
